Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 22887 of 2023

Applicant :- Balveer
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Keshav Hari Dixit,Jitendra Kumar,Purushottam Dixit

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Keshav Hari Dixit, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 36 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Qadarchouk, District Badaun during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and his family members including husband of the deceased and according to the FIR marriage of the sister of the informant was performed with the son of applicant in the year 2021 and after marriage applicant and his family members including the husband of the deceased used to torture the sister of the informant for want of Buffalo, Rs.
50,000/- and a motorcycle and thereafter on 22.01.2023 they committed the murder of his sister.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless.

He further submits that applicant is father-in-law and he has been made accused on the basis of general allegation and no specific allegation has been made against him and Balveer vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8062780/
1
from perusal of the post mortem report, it appears that deceased committed suicide as cause of death was hanging and her hyoid bone was found intact.

He further submits that as marriage of the deceased was performed with the son of applicant and two years have been passed but she could not be conceived therefore only due to this reason under frustration, she committed suicide.

He further submits that mother-in-law of the deceased has already released on bail vide order dated 26.4.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 15064 of 2023 and case of applicant is at par with her and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 24.03.2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 15064 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the daughter-in-law of the applicant died within two years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that applicant is father-in-law and there is no specific allegation against him and according to the post mortem deceased died due to hanging and her hyoid bone was found intact.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. Applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and his daughter-in-law died within two years of marriage under abnormal circumstances and there was allegation of demand of dowry but it appears from the record that there is no specific allegation has been made against the applicant and post mortem report suggests that deceased committed suicide as cause of death according to the doctor was ante mortem hanging and nothing abnormal was detected in her hyoid bone.

Further,
mother-in-law of the deceased has been released on bail and case of applicant is at par with her.
8. Therefore considering the fact that applicant is father-in-law and no specific allegations have been made against him, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant - Balveer be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
11. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
